narr: Severe thunderstorms moved across the area and produced hail, some wind damage and a little bit of flooding.
ev: Flash flooding was reported along Atkins Creek on the northeast side of the city of Montgomery. Several motorists were stranded in high water along FM 1097. A few homes in the Terra Vista neighborhood also took on some water. Time was estimated by radar.
